title: ID0465646-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / S9 170004084] "P04_PRE_CHARGE" --> "P00_UNKNOWN"
description:

Solution: EV issue -> we are building up the voltage properly and EV sends a PilotState B

additional_info.subject: ID0465646-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / S9 170004084] Check on logs CRM:00263000222
additional_info.body:
Dear
Rosita Abate
,
We are sending this email regarding a problem with your charger:
MP / S9 170004084
which led to the opened ticket:
0465646
.
Problem description:
"
On november 3, a client tried to charge between 5:21:34 PM and 5:23:02 PM CU TIME (18:21:34 and 18:23:02 Italy time) but the charger didn't deliver any power. Later he also tried on the charger 170004085, between 6:05:05 and 6:19:14 (19:05:05 and 19:19:14 Italy time), but also this time there was no energy delivery.
Can you please check the logs?"
We have reviewed your charging session logs and noted the following sequence regarding the connector state:
At 17:21:45 – The station detected your vehicle connection (PilotState transitioned from "A" to "B2").
At 17:22:01 – The system recognized the vehicle’s request to initiate DC charging (PilotState "B2" to "C2").
At 17:22:23 – The station detected a change back to a standby connection state (PilotState "C2" to "B2").
At 17:22:25 – The system transitioned to a fault or error state (PilotState "B2" to "E").
From this, we can confirm that the charging session was interrupted immediately after the pre-charge phase. The full session logs have been downloaded and forwarded to our expert team, who will analyze the issue in detail as soon as possible.
We will keep you updated regarding our findings and the recommended next steps.
We really appreciate your help and look forward to getting this sorted out soon!
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Guilherme Andre De Verissimo Dias
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: ID0465646-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / S9 170004084] Check on logs CRM:00263000222
additional_info.body:
Hello Rosita,
I checked the logs and found in the communications logs that the vehicle is not starting the session for an unknown reason. During PreCharge phase, we give to the EV the voltage that he requests and move forward to the Energy Transfer and soon as the EV gives us the OK to go:
As you can see we are complying with the requested value and the EV suddenly stops the charging:
When the EV changes the PilotState to B it means that he doesn't want to proceed with charging.
From our side, everything looks ok, I checked from the last 7 days and I see multiple sessions on DC2:
Let me know if this answered to your question and I can close the ticket.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
